values.note: 2026 (operator's 'Book Now for 2026' rate page), plus tax: 30-amp back-in with water $40-45, 30-amp pull-through $43-48. Smaller 20-amp water/electric sites 'for medium campers, truck campers, popups and tents' $38-40 (not taken as the base: not stated to fit a 23-ft motorhome); 15-amp tent sites $36-70; Kamper Kabins $85-105, vintage glampers $78. First night is the deposit; $10 processing fee on cancellations 14+ days out.

note: Small family-owned campground at 1923 River Road near Frankfort/Elberta, inside the Betsie River State Game Refuge about 400 swampy feet from the river (no river access from camp). Self-described as 'not a big concrete pad RV park' but takes campers and travel trailers; quiet, family-oriented, room for a boat on most sites. Betsie Valley Trail at hand; beaches about 3 miles. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's own site (2026): 30-amp with water, no sewer, pull-throughs, showers/dump/camp store, reservable online via ResNexus; phone (231) 352-9535 matches. Changed fees base 38 -> 40 (the $38-40 20-amp sites are for 'medium campers, truck campers, popups and tents'; the 30-amp back-in for campers starts at $40); high $48 confirmed. Added water yes / sewer no, season (April-ish to October-ish), booking platform/url. Note corrected: the camp is ~400 ft of swamp from the river, not on it. Price gate passes ($40-48).
